\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} FOMC-patched design (the scheduled 18 March 2020 meeting added, the proximity ramps not winsorized); every linear arm and the trees' FOMC arms are walked on it.  Cells marked \dag{} (the trees' Panel A rows other than FOMC) are on the pre-patch FOMC design, against the pre-patch full set: only the FOMC group is rerun on the patched design (the trees' add arms other than FOMC and the removal of FOMC hold no FOMC column, so their forecasts are the same on both designs). Each cell is the percentage change in QLIKE of a pooled intraday forecast against its reference, with the Diebold--Mariano statistic of the difference in parentheses (negative: the arm has the lower loss); every bar of Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos} is scored (2014--2024) and the test runs on daily average QLIKE. Panel A removes one predictor group (its series' trailing averages and availability shares) from the full set; Panel B adds one group to the HAR benchmark; Panel C adds the semivariances RS$^{+}$ and RS$^{-}$ of the last half hour (SHAR), the HARQ interaction of realized variance with the square root of realized quarticity, and the negative half-hour returns at every HAR horizon (LHAR), all from the same E-mini one-minute data. The last rows of Panel D set the full set against the same class's HAR benchmark plus the futures' realized moments (RM, Panel B's first row) and plus the FOMC calendar (Panel B's last row). Every model keeps the full set's frozen hyperparameters (the linear penalties chosen on the 2013 pre-sample fold for the full set; one configuration per tree method).  The random forest is run for Panel B and for the realized-moment group of Panel A only.  Series that start after the data enter as zero until the rolling window holds 3,000 days of their history (Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}), so the implied-volatility, sentiment and volatility-demand rows of Panels A and B measure those series only from the dates in the text. Panel E scores the same forecasts on the bars on which the group's value averages are live (all three StockTwits series from \rhabLiveSentStart{}; the VIX from \rhabLiveIvStart{}; the VIX and VIX3M from \rhabLiveIvbStart{}; the volatility-demand series from \rhabLiveVdStart{} until their feed stops on \rhabLiveVdEnd{}), subsamples of \rhabLiveSentDays{}, \rhabLiveIvDays{}, \rhabLiveIvbDays{} and \rhabLiveVdDays{} trading days.
\end{tablenotes}
